source: Determinism pins of the synthetic trade profiles the fake cube serves (mini, standard, deep, uniform, skew): trade count, base-cell count, cell count and decoded size of each tier, and the sha256 of the decoded recent block. Not market data.
notes: The only permitted self-referential fixture: it pins that the generator is stable and is never an expected value elsewhere. The injected pack's compressed length is deliberately NOT pinned (gzip output depends on the zlib version); its decoded payload sizes are. Rewrite with UPDATE_PINS=1 node --test tests/unit/fake-routes.test.js after a deliberate change of profiles.js, trades.js or rng.js.
